Text_BattleTowerWelcomesYou:
BATTLE TOWER
welcomes you!

I could show you
to a BATTLE ROOM.
Text_WantToGoIntoABattleRoom:
Want to go into a
BATTLE ROOM?
Text_RightThisWayToYourBattleRoom:
Right this way to
your BATTLE ROOM.
Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_1:
BATTLE TOWER is a
facility made for #MON battles.

Countless #MON
trainers gather

from all over to
hold battles in

specially designed
BATTLE ROOMS.

There are many
BATTLE ROOMS in the BATTLE TOWER.

Each ROOM holds
seven trainers.

If you defeat the
seven in a ROOM,

and you have a
good record, you

could become the
ROOM's LEADER.

All LEADERS will
be recorded in the

HONOR ROLL for
posterity.

You may challenge
in up to five

BATTLE ROOMS each
day.

However, you may
battle only once a

day in any given
ROOM.

To interrupt a
session, you must

SAVE. If not, you
won't be able to

resume your ROOM
challenge.

Text_BattleTowerRules:
Three #MON may
enter battles.

All three must be
different.

The items they
hold must also be different.

Certain #MON
may also have

level restrictions
placed on them.
